claims.statement: The port's springs are native gpuix motion springs with the source's numbers: fast is 80 ms and moderate 160 ms with bounce 0, slow 240 ms with bounce 0.12.
pickNearest is ported verbatim from the source's use-fluid-hover, so a pointer in a gap, padding or past the last row still resolves to the nearest row.
Entering the hover container starts a new session, and a new session remounts the highlight so it appears at the row instead of sliding from the previous one; a reflow snaps rather than glides.
A keyboard move calls releasePointer so the scroll it causes does not re-pick a row under a stationary pointer.

Press-shrink is one absolutely positioned PressFill quad 1px outside the pressable whose four edges and radius are pulled in on press, not a spread shadow; the label is a position: relative box after the fill, with no zIndex.
The theme is a System/Light/Dark signal defaulting to System; System is fed by gpuix createAppearance and the choice is mirrored to the renderer's setAppearance.
Demos are found by scanning src/demos with Bun.Glob in a Bun plugin that serves them as the virtual:demos module (also used by Bun.build), so a new component edits no shared registry.
Every drift entry carries a Cause of gpuix gap, port choice or not ported yet.
@gpuix/solid is installed as a file: copy so its solid-js peer resolves from the app, @gpuix/native stays a link with a workspace override, and base-ui-solid-gpuix is a workspace member.
scripts/check-single-instance.ts fails when solid-js or @gpuix/solid resolves to more than one copy across the app and base-ui-solid-gpuix.
noUncheckedIndexedAccess is turned off in tsconfig and Biome's a11y rule group is off.
Playground variants are picked with Math.random, which makes screenshot captures differ between runs.
The theme cross-fade mounts a UniversalStyle layer, flips the palette 20 ms later and removes the layer 200 ms after the flip; captures and tests that call setThemeChoice directly skip it.
The card's dismiss chip reveals through groupHover and groupFocusWithin of a named card group, and the colour picker's format label darkens through groupHover, instead of hover signals.
The table row lights from the fluid hover's pick rather than the pointer, so it stays signal-driven and not a groupHover.

Fonts are the source's two Inter 4.0 variable files (upright and italic), registered as the family 'Inter Variable', and theme.ts weight tokens are the source's fontVariationSettings strings pairing wght with opsz (semibold is wght 550, opsz 18).

StableLabel holds two hidden copies (normal and semibold) beside the visible one in its grid cell, so the cell is as wide as the wider of the two and does not change width with the weight, unlike the source's semibold-only ghost, which shrinks a label whose normal copy is wider. On gpuix b03d4e27 the second ghost's cost is within noise (sidebar-sweep draw p95 -0.35 to +0.30 ms over seven pages; it was +1.0-1.7 ms on 5fda771a), and it is kept because the box must not change width and check-weight-widths pins it.

scripts/check-weight-widths.tsx asserts that gpuix's weight width delta equals the browser's rather than the source's 0.4 px claim, and steps the held motion clock across the ease to assert that a StableLabel's box and its row neighbours' boxes are exactly where they were (no tolerance); for labels narrower at semibold it asserts the cell is identical light and heavy and equals the wider of the normal and semibold copies; it runs at 1x scale only.

The port keeps the off-screen culling in src/lib/cull.ts: re-measured on gpuix poc b03d4e27 (live, two alternating pairs) and again headless on 196d69ce with a culling-off knockout, turning it off was worse on every page that differed and better on none (b03d4e27: showcase idle CPU 45 to 80%, input-message 3.3 to 51.5%; 196d69ce: showcase 31/27 to 69/70% CPU, input-message 1.3/0.5 to 53/36%), so the earlier plan to remove it once gpuix #46 lands was not carried out.

The changelog Releases jump recomputes its scroll target on each page scroll and scrolls again when the target moved by more than 1 px, until the month is within 1 px of its margin, the page end is reached or the user scrolls away, because culled entries above the month un-pin to taller real heights during a smooth scroll and a single scroll landed the month 4-5 px low.

The file-thumbnail spinner, thinking indicator, carousel-dots autoplay fill and the scripted cursors run as native gpuix animations rather than on the shared 16 ms onFrame JS clock; since gpuix 83bab5a7 a motion value's animate() returns playback controls, which the plain-vs-fluid cursor uses (one animate paused and played in place), while the carousel fill and the skill pages' script cursor still stop and restart; only thinking-steps' chevron, the fluid-hover lists demo and the cost meter still subscribe to onFrame.
The thinking-steps demo cards start paused and play once at least half of the card is in view, observed through observeVisibleRatio in cull.ts, pausing below 10% visible while keeping elapsed time.
pnpm check:scenarios runs every scripts/check-* file and lists all failures at the end rather than stopping at the first failing check.

Fluid hover reads its container's bounding rect on every pick and containerBox() is a fresh read, with no cache; the earlier cached box (introduced because a live getBoundingClientRect cost a layout pass of about 6 ms on poc e5231304) was dropped on b03d4e27 when it measured within noise, since a read after a paint-only write runs no layout pass (gpuix #47).

Fluid hover measures each row as integers relative to the container (toOffsetRect rounds top, left, width and height), like the source's offsetTop/offsetWidth reads, because gpuix has no offset* and reports fractional rects; the earlier reason that gpuix laid authored lengths on whole device pixels is gone on 83bab5a7, which keeps an authored length's fraction.

The button's loading spinner is drawn natively with the source's spinner-move and spinner-dash keyframes (strokeDashoffset and strokeDasharray on a pathLength 100 path), a culled button holds the first frame, and reduced motion is not honoured, as in the source; the file-thumbnail spinner remains a sliding motion.circle because rotation needs a transform gpuix lacks.

The menu-item check and the input-copy check and cross draw and retract through the shared CheckMark (motion.path on pathLength), which takes a viewBox, a drawOnMount option and a colour fade so input-copy can use the source's own paths in a 20 x 16 box.

check-weight-widths measures each string at the rendered 13 px using gpuix's fractional bounds and compares to the browser's delta with a parity tolerance of 0.03 px, replacing the earlier 130 px scale-up with a 0.2 px tolerance that compensated for whole-pixel bounds.

Demo screenshot scenarios scroll an element into view through the shared scrollNearTop in src/lib/demo-kit.tsx, which counts consecutive wheels that moved nothing and throws on the third instead of treating an unmoved element as the page end.

The tabs-subtle unfolding label's clip is the source's structure: a block with fontSize 16 and lineHeight 24px holding the label directly, so the 24px strut line box comes from the style rather than an authored height and marginTop (labelTop is removed), after gpuix 83bab5a7 seated the trimmed inline-grid on the baseline; the residue is a baseline up to 0.45px below Chrome's.

The button page's native loading spinner makes the page a looping-native-animation page: the source's always-loading Saving button takes it from 3.8% to 41% idle CPU, and on gpuix 196d69ce its ticks still draw whole because of the page's PlayText input and the spinner's positioned or translucent ancestors.

The carousel-dots fill reset and play are a single effect, because Solid does not guarantee effect order and a play running before the reset read the old fill (1) and never started or had its animation ended by the reset's jump; the next slide is requested from the animation's finished promise alone, which gpuix 83bab5a7 resolves only on a natural finish or complete(), so the former current flag and fill-reached-1 guards are removed.

The table row declares no border-color transition: gpuix does not draw it on a collapsed border and running it rebuilt layout subtrees of the table's siblings every frame (5120 builds over a hover glide against 12 for the sidebar); check-table counts the glide's layout builds against the sidebar's.

check-scroll-area runs half-pixel content (29 rows, 581.5 px) and whole-pixel content, reaching the end by wheel, thumb drag and End key, and checks that the scroll end lands exactly on scrollHeight - clientHeight so the track wheel chains to the page, and that a continuous wheel gesture stays latched to the area it started on.

The command menu list writes its scroll offset with the plain scrollTop setter (gpuix f7b62f11 lays out only what is pending, so the renderer.scrollTo workaround was dropped), and its motion-value change handler writes the live value rather than the event payload so a change queued before a snap cannot write the old position back.
A page switch writes the page scroller to the top with the plain scrollTop setter before swapping the page signal, and throws if the scroller is not mounted.

The changelog release spy defers its first scroller reading to a 0 ms timer that runs after the first draw, showing the newest month meanwhile, because reading the scroller in the mount effect laid out the whole page (about 70 ms) before the first draw; its cleanup clears the timer.

check-site-nav verifies a page switch lands at the top by reading scroll metrics right after the click, which draws the pending frame, so it asserts the new page's first frame rather than a settled state.

check-command-menu holds an arrow at macOS key-repeat timing with the motion clock running, bounds layout passes per drain by a count, and replays the wrap with back-to-back keys and one draw part way to catch stale change events writing the old position.

scripts/perf-page-switch.tsx is a headless tool that splits a sidebar-click page switch into mount JS, first draw and later frames; one process per slug gives a cold first visit because slugs in one process share text-shape caches, and runs are comparable only at similar load average.

The first draw of a long page (Changelog, Showcase, Command Menu) still builds, lays out and shapes every node because culling only hides regions after an IntersectionObserver reports against a first layout; this is recorded as a gpuix question in the README rather than worked around.

check-thinking-steps clicks the images button only after its bounds have been identical for eight consecutive polls (settleBounds), instead of a fixed 600 ms wait, because a spring's tail moves a box by fractions of a pixel.
pnpm footprint runs one fresh child process per page and compiles the child first so Bun's transpile cost stays out of memory numbers; --source runs it from source instead.

In --window mode the footprint driver flags an occluded page and exits 1, and samples the frontmost app each second to report the key share, flagging rows that are neither mostly key nor mostly not as mixed, because gpui paces a non-key window at one frame per 33.3 ms.

The footprint window child reuses the shipped windowOptions from src/lib/window-options.ts but overrides the width to 1280, the width of the Electron comparison since the site's layout drops its sidebar below 1280, and recentres the resized window with windowPlacement.

--tour mounts one child, visits every other page through the app's own navigate (optionally several rounds), and reads the footprint fresh at each stop and afterward, so session retention is measured separately from per-page cost.
The app build and the footprint child build compile with autoloadBunfig: false so the compiled binary does not read the bunfig.toml of the directory it is launched from.

nativeCjsPlugin is shared in scripts/native-cjs-plugin.ts and redirects both the @gpuix/native import and the ../index.js import made from the package's own dist files (the test renderer) to the CJS entry, so compiled headless children can embed the native addon.

On gpuix 196d69ce a paint-only loop (colour, opacity, SVG stroke) is drawn as a patch of its own unit instead of a whole frame, unless an input or textarea is on the page (Unsteady), the loop sits under a positioned or translucent ancestor (UnknownUnit), or it is a motion value; ThinkingIndicator's words share one cell of a position-less grid slot and are positioned only while they roll, which took its page from every tick whole to about 62 patched ticks a second.
The thinking-steps step wrapper no longer sets position: relative, because it anchored nothing and made gpui decline the shimmer's ticks.

pnpm footprint headless prints patched/s and full/s (draws gpuix made by patching the previous frame against frames built whole) and a why column naming the top two reasons for whole frames from the declines and unpatchable counters, which name the reason but not the element.

The app root viewport sets WebkitFontSmoothing 'antialiased' once, mirroring the source's html/body rule, and every text inherits it; gpuix f7b62f11 added the style key, so the earlier 9-42% heavier-text gap is closed.

The changelog release spy treats the page as at its end when scrollTop + clientHeight >= scrollHeight, with no slack, because gpuix f7b62f11 ends the scroll range exactly at scrollHeight - clientHeight.
